public_rationale: On July 21, 2025, Zitron wrote that OpenAI needed to convert by the end of the year or it was effectively dead. OpenAI said on October 28, 2025 that it had completed its recapitalization. The condition he named did not happen, so his forecast about what would follow it can be neither confirmed nor falsified.
limitations: This record does not assess whether OpenAI's recapitalization, in which the nonprofit keeps control, is the full conversion Zitron had in mind.
It does not assess his separate statement in the same sentence that OpenAI 'will die without continual funding'.
